notes: כִּי is a written conjunction and takes the protasis If, so nothing is added at the head of the casuistic clause (rule 55); the apodosis waw takes then (rule 14).

כְּ is rendered by the compound as in, a single rendering no other morpheme owns a part of (rule 30), headed on as (rule 24); the same treatment is used at v.5, which keeps the two verses consistent without either deciding the other.
תַזְרִיעַ → conceive seed is headed on conceive, with the competing head on seed named in that unit's note under rules 44 and 8.
The ASV marginal 'separation' for נִדָּה is a lexical alternative and does not touch the alignment (rule 38).
